links.outcome: Simulation accuracy under distribution shift on external ICU cohorts from two hospitals
links.effect: External validation on 22,689 ICU patients from two hospitals showed moderate degradation under distribution shifts, though simulation remained stable.
links.quote: External validation on 22,689 ICU patients from two hospitals showed moderate degradation under distribution shifts with stable simulation.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM organ-system simulators with reinforcement-guided coordination for digital twin simulation
Counterfactual treatment simulation using synthetic patient trajectories
Training early warning classifiers on synthetic data

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and evaluating an LLM multi-agent physiological simulator (Organ-Agents) for ICU/sepsis trajectory modeling and counterfactual treatment simulation, evaluated retrospectively and by critical care physicians.
